title: Sembawang / Canberra new spot
description: New north-fringe opening (food or browse-worthy) that’s easy from Woodlands. Surfaces only when something actually launches — not a park-you-already-know tip.
parking: Mall or HDB multi-storey — generally easy evenings.
when: When the new venue’s hours allow

title: Sports Hub / Kallang — special event week
description: Only when a concert, match, or public event is on at the Sports Hub. Not a “go walk around the stadium” filler.
parking: Sports Hub multi-storey — event pricing and queues apply; arrive early.
why: Event-driven near-ish outing from the north.

title: West pop-up or new concept (limited run)
description: When a limited retail or F&B pop-up lands west (Jurong / west malls / concept spaces), it earns a slot. Skip empty weeks.
when: Pop-up dates only — confirm before driving

title: Gardens by the Bay — current outdoor programme
description: Only when a seasonal light show, floral display, or evening programme is running. Short outdoor segments after 6pm; Cloud Forest / Flower Dome as AC backup.
parking: Gardens / MBS multi-storey. Evening rates apply.
heatNote: Outdoors only after the heat breaks. Domes are the AC escape hatch.
why: Programme-driven, not a permanent garden stroll recap.

title: Botanic Gardens — special evening event
description: When NParks or a partner runs a special evening programme, concert, or seasonal highlight — not a default Swan Lake lap. Finish with AC dinner nearby if you stay out.
parking: Botanic Gardens car parks; free periods may apply for short stays — check signs.
heatNote: Evening only. Midday walks are not the product.
why: Event filter keeps this from becoming a park you already know.

title: Sentosa limited-time outdoor / beach event
description: Only when a festival, night market, or limited beach programme is advertised. Evening preferred; AC backup at nearby malls after.
parking: Sentosa / HarbourFront multi-storey — weekend evenings queue; consider earlier arrival.
heatNote: Beach heat is real — go late or don’t go.
why: Special event, not a generic island day.

title: Coney Island — cool-season / evening window
description: Only recommend in lower-heat windows or late day for a short loop. Not a weekly default — surfaces when weather cooperates and you want a north outdoor change of scene.
parking: Punggol Point / nearby public lots — check NParks access notes.
heatNote: Skip on scorching weeks. Short loop + water + AC dinner after.
why: Weather-gated north outdoor — not a permanent listing.

title: New rooftop / sky bar evening (after dark)
description: When a new rooftop or sky lounge opens or launches a sunset promo, it’s a heat-smart outdoor-ish option — go after 6:30pm. AC indoor bar as fallback.
parking: Building multi-storey; evening rates vary widely.
heatNote: Rooftops at 3pm in July are a trap. Evening only.
why: New venue + evening outdoor energy without pretending midday parks are fun.
